QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init()` (`:566-576`) calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` itself, using a mutex-wrapped variant when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says init uses a mutex-wrapped variant when threading is on, but it never says a plain pair is installed otherwise or that the choice is made at compile time, so it only partly covers the item.
